title: Tutto Gusto Wine Cellar | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Tutto Gusto Wine Cellar Located in World Showcase at EPCOT Experience the flavors of Italy at this cozy wine bar. Recalling an authentic Italian wine cellar, Tutto Gusto offers over 200 bottles of Italian wines—plus beer and a small-plates menu of meats, cheeses, panini, pasta and desserts.View Menu Italian Bar-Lounge View Discounts Operating Hours – 12:30 PM to 9:00 PM Valid admission required.
